wins.label: AIPC market leadership
wins.evidence: Intel Core Ultra volume more than doubled sequentially in Q2 and is already powering AI capabilities across more than 300 applications and 500 AI models

wins.label: Process technology progress
wins.evidence: Intel 18A PDK 1.0 released, Panther Lake and Clearwater Forest powered on, on track for manufacturing-ready by end of year

wins.label: Cost reduction plan execution
wins.evidence: Targeting head count reduction of greater than 15% by end of 2025, OpEx reduction to $17.5 billion in 2025, more than 20% below prior estimates

wins.label: Capital efficiency improvements
wins.evidence: Gross CapEx reduced to $25-27 billion in 2024, net capital spending $11-13 billion including SCIP programs, over 20% reduction from plan

wins.label: Foundry customer momentum
wins.evidence: Foundry Services revenue more than doubled sequentially, $15 billion in lifetime deal value of committed deals, significant expansion in advanced packaging

risks.label: Gross margin deterioration
risks.evidence: Q2 gross margin of 38.7% significantly below expectations, driven by accelerated AIPC ramp and higher wafer costs from Oregon to Ireland transition

risks.label: Foundry profitability challenges
risks.evidence: Foundry operating loss of $2.8 billion, expected to continue at approximately same rate in Q3, more than 85% of wafer volumes still from pre-EUV nodes with uncompetitive cost structure

risks.label: Weak near-term demand outlook
risks.evidence: Q3 expected to be impacted by modest inventory digestion in CCG, DCAI and cyclical businesses trending below forecast, pace of recovery slower than expected

risks.label: Competitive positioning uncertainty
risks.evidence: Primary x86 competitor expected to be up double digits in client space while Intel guides flat to down, questions raised about whether cost cuts alone address competitive gaps

risks.label: Dividend suspension and liquidity concerns
risks.evidence: Suspending dividend at beginning of Q4, adjusted free cash flow expected to be modestly negative in 2024, restructuring charges not yet estimated
